offers_products.reason: Cloud-based HCM software (payroll, time, talent, benefits administration) sold as SaaS is a main offering.

offers_services.reason: Payroll processing, tax filing, PEO, HR outsourcing, compliance services and benefits administration are core services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are small, midsized and large businesses buying payroll and HR solutions for their employees.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells payroll, HCM, PEO and compliance solutions to small, midsized and large businesses.

recurring_revenue.reason: Payroll, HR and PEO services are subscription-style, recurring per-pay-period and multi-year client relationships.

cyclical_demand.reason: Payroll and tax compliance are essential and mandatory; clients can't easily cut them, though headcount-linked fees dip somewhat.

big_ticket.reason: Payroll and HR services are billed per pay run or subscription, small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from cloud HCM technology and processing platform, with experts supporting; software would keep running without staff.

large_customers.reason: Serves small, midsized and large businesses; a large base is small and midsized firms, so not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software and service business needs data centers and development, not heavy plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Customer-size answer is mixed: ADP serves all business sizes, with many small and midsized clients.
